headline: EPS jumps sharply sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Yuhan reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩950, up 162.4% q/q from ₩362 and up 56.5% y/y from ₩607.
summary_long: EPS of ₩950 rose 162.4% sequentially from ₩362 and 56.5% year-over-year from ₩607. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
